purpose: Separate feasibility in field space from fresh U-Net fit to a dense self-generated field; single diagnostic loss, no search
loss: A/B mean concentration MSE divided by fixed teacher mean-square concentration; no relative/consistency terms in this separate diagnostic
all_other_network_initial_optimizer_sett: same fresh registered U-Net, same seed c0 alpha; AdamW2e-4 wd1e-4 clip1 cosine300 each16updates
criterion: physical ABH and E separately reported, not selection
scope_limit: one teacher probe only; failure within 200 updates does not prove network incapable; no automatic architecture/loss/coefficient search
device: CPU two threads; may coexist with independent two-thread original comparison
